cycle_timing.method: Cycle timing definitions: Sectioning = pickup_completed to section_completed; Pickup = max(latest section_completed, latest prior dropoff_completed if present) to pickup_completed, falling back to latest section_search_started when no section_completed exists; Dropoff = pickup_completed to dropoff_completed; Full Auto = full_auto_cycle_completed to next full_auto_cycle_completed. Boxes show p25-p75, median is the center line, whiskers show p10-p90. Pairs over 300 seconds and app starts/resets/date rollovers are excluded.

metrics.definition: Latest section/dropoff completion to pickup completion, or latest section search when no section completion exists
metrics.label: Pickup

metrics.definition: Full-auto completion to next full-auto completion
metrics.label: Full Auto
